name: Ten Play
summary: Ten Play has no return of its own. It deals the same starting hand ten times and draws each separately; the return is that of the paytable underneath.

facts.label: Return
facts.value: Same as the single-hand game with the same paytable — look the paytable up on its base game tile

facts.label: Strategy
facts.value: Identical to single-hand strategy for that paytable

facts.label: Swings
facts.value: Ten hands share one deal, so each deal risks ten bets at once

preserve.reason: Ten bets at risk every deal — size the denomination down

return.reason: No return of its own; depends entirely on the base paytable

rewards.reason: Ten times the coin-in per deal — check total wager below

practice.reason: Same strategy as the base game — train that instead
